rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 How to Win 3 Setup 4 On Your Turn 5 Actions Overview Play as a powerful Rail Magnate, operating in Bengal. Over two rounds, compete to fulfill contracts, transport crates between Benaras and Calcutta using your own or rival trains, and invest your profits to earn points. How to Win Win by having the most VP at the end of the second round based on the below scoring conditions: Increase the value of Asset markers to score VP for each corresponding Asset tile Gain Deal Tiles, multiply them with the sum of VP values shown on all their Agencies Move up the Performance Track to earn end game VP Score VP for each Investment Marker Gain VP for Secret Investor Bonus Setup At the beginning of the game, starting with the first player, each player receives Rs.2, with each successive player in clockwise order receiving Rs.1 more than the previous player. Starting with first player, each player selects one pairing of Setup card and Asset/Deal tile. This combination determines the starting location of their Freight Cars, their initial Assets, and their turn order for the first round. On Your Turn During your turn, play one card from your hand to an unoccupied slot on your player board. Slide it up or down to do either the top Development Action or the bottom Logistics Action. After placing your Action card, you may perform the action(s) shown on the card itself and the uncovered Company action. The order in which you resolve them is up to you, but you must complete each action fully before starting the other Actions Receive/Pay Money : Receive money if money icon is White and pay if it is Red. Move the Cash Flow Marker forward or backward accordingly. Advance Market Markers : Move the Benaras, Calcutta of Financial Advisor up the Market Track. Receive any instant bonus when the Financial Advisor reaches or exceeds the level. Increase Asset Value : Advance the indicated Asset Value marker(s) the specified number of steps on the Asset Value track. Establish an Agency : take the indicated Agency and place it on your Agency track. Load Crates : Remove one (or more) goods from your active Contracts and place them onto a Freight Car. Move Trains : Move Freight Cars across a number of Rail Segments. Boost Performance : Move the Gear token along the Performance Track. Ship Crates : Place the indicated number of Crates from your Contracts onto the different Ships of the Shipping zone.

[Rating: 4/10] The core gameplay of Movers & Shakers was not without merit. Load and move trains, attempting to get more rewards than your opponents.   Unfortunately, both the action selection and the action outcome is unnecessarily obfuscated. Cards are played to a player board and each unique combination has a unique outcome, which besides the core actions and of loading and moving, lets you advance on numerous tracks.   Whatever happened to the old euro school of few meaningful decisions?

[Rating: 5/10] A pretty basic game where you play cards, move up on various tracks and trigger bonuses here and there. I don't really see much depth there, the game kind of plays itself in a way. I bet it's a nightmare to move around those trains in person, especially at a higher player count. Digital play on BGA omited the inconvenience, but the game was still not to my liking. Which is unfortunate, because it did look promising at first.
